moved.sentence: A `Gemfile` MUST have one global `source`, and its `Gemfile.lock` MUST be committed.

judged.note: Both MUSTs kept in two rules: one global source; Gemfile.lock committed.

moved.sentence: Development and test gems SHOULD be kept in groups, and installs SHOULD omit them where they are not needed with `bundle config set --local without <group>`.

judged.note: Both SHOULDs kept in two rules: dev and test gems grouped; installs omit unneeded groups with bundle config set --local without <group>.

moved.sentence: Code SHOULD raise with `raise`, not `fail`, and SHOULD define domain errors as subclasses of `StandardError`.

judged.note: Both SHOULDs kept in two rules: raise not fail; domain errors subclass StandardError.

moved.sentence: Style SHOULD be configured in `.rubocop.yml`, and the project SHOULD set `AllCops: TargetRubyVersion` or let it come from the gemspec, `.ruby-version` or `.tool-versions`.

judged.note: Both SHOULDs kept in two rules: style in .rubocop.yml; TargetRubyVersion set or taken from the gemspec, .ruby-version or .tool-versions.
The look-for part keeps the instruction to review changed Ruby against this guideline; the self-link becomes 'the rules above', this artifact's own rules part.
